question: Do the frozen DON8/EMA8/VOL8 rules, as the equal-capital v3 portfolio, earn positive net returns on crypto perpetuals no repository protocol has ever evaluated, over their full MEXC history?
registration_note: Registered 2026-09-26, before any strategy result on these coins was computed. They are chosen mechanically: the top 60 MEXC USDT perps by 24h turnover on 2026-09-26, excluding the 10 development coins, keeping those with at least 300 8h bars in 2020-06..2020-12. Only kline availability was checked. Their 2026 price correlations (no strategy P&L) appeared in the effective-bets analysis for UNI, DOT, LTC and BCH.
evaluation_rule: run exactly once from a commit containing this file

selection_rule.pool: MEXC USDT perps, top 60 by 24h turnover on 2026-09-26

economics.funding: primary is without funding, for comparability with the pre-window holdout; a funding-charged sensitivity using Binance USDT-M history as a proxy is pre-registered as secondary
economics.portfolio: equal capital across sleeves that have data that day, rebalanced daily at 00:00 UTC

primary.test: Newey-West t (5 lags) of the mean daily net return

secondary_descriptive: Binance-funding-charged version of the primary series

interpretation_limits: These coins share the crypto factor with the development coins, so they add little independent breadth; this tests the rules on unseen instruments, not on an independent asset class.
2024-2026 overlaps the development window in time, though not in instruments.
